name: Blackbird's Hideaway Resort & Campground
note: The former Graceville Inn & RV Park on SR-77 north of Graceville, renamed and being refurbished as a small resort with an inn, tiki bar, pool and laundry. Full-hookup RV sites: 20/30-amp sites for rigs up to 30 ft $45/night, 50-amp sites $55-65 (2026); tent sites. RVs over 10 years old need photo approval before a booking is accepted. NEW OPERATION, NOT YET REVIEWED: soft opening Oct 10, 2026, no reviews anywhere as of Oct 2026 - check recent reviews before relying on it. --Claude
